app.title: University Simulator
app.tagline: Zilolongele isemesta yakho yokuqala ngaphambi kokuthi kube ngokoqobo.
home.hook: Cishe abafundi bonyaka wokuqala abangu-620 000 baxhaswa yi-NSFAS ngo-2023. Cishe abangu-130 000 kuphela ababesaxhaswa ngonyaka olandelayo.
home.what: Dlala amasonto ayisishiyagalombili esemesta yakho yokuqala yasenyuvesi emizuzwini engaba yi-10. Phatha imali, amamaki nenhlalakahle ezinkingeni abafundi bonyaka wokuqala abahlangabezana nazo ngempela, bese ugcina uhlelo lokusinda lwempilo yangempela.
home.privacy: Ayikho i-akhawunti, akukho ukubhalisa. Izimpendulo zakho zihlala kule divayisi.
home.f1.title: Izikali ezintathu
home.f1.body: Imali, amamaki nenhlalakahle. Sonke isinqumo sihwebelanisa esinye nesinye.
home.f2.title: Usizo lwangempela lwasekhampasi
home.f2.body: Ukufuna usizo kukhombisa insizakalo yangempela enyuvesi yakho nokuthi ungayithola kanjani.
home.f3.title: Uhlelo oluzigcinela lona
home.f3.body: Ibhajethi eyakhelwe emalini yakho yangempela, uhlelo lwemali ephuzile nabantu bakho bosizo.
lang.label: Ulimi
setup.institutionHint: Isikhungo ngasinye sinamakhampasi aso, izinsizakalo, izindleko nokubukeka kwaso. Yileso osikhethayo kuphela esilandwa efonini yakho. Lezi ezimbili ziyimiboniso eqanjiwe.
setup.incomeHint: Yokudla, ukugibela, idatha nezidingo zakho. Ungafaki izimali zesikole, noma irenti ekhokhwa ngqo e-res noma kumnikazi wendlu.
setup.incomeBasics: Izidingo eziyisisekelo eduze ne-{area} zibiza cishe u-{essentials} ngenyanga.
setup.family: Ingabe umndeni wakho ungadinga imali kuwe?
setup.startMoney: Uqala uno-{money} ephaketheni. Isibonelelo sakho sikhokhwa ngaphezu kwalokhu njengoba udlala, futhi singafika sekwephuzile.
tier.gap.title: Imali yakho ayanele izidingo eziyisisekelo
tier.gap.body: Izidingo eziyisisekelo zibiza cishe u-{essentials} ngenyanga lapho uzohlala khona, kanti wena uno-{income}: igebe lika-{gap}. Lena yinkinga yoxhaso, akulona iphutha lebhajethi. Akukho kwabiwa okungakulungisa, kodwa lezi zinyathelo zingasiza:
tier.gap.step1: Bhalisela usizo lokudla lwasekhampasi ngesonto 1, ngaphambi kokuthi imali iphele.
tier.gap.step2: Buza ehhovisi losizo lwezimali ukuthi ungathola okwengeziwe yini: i-NSFAS, imixhaso noma izimali zosizo.
tier.gap.step3: Funa umsebenzi wasekhampasi wamahora ambalwa ngesonto ongeke ulimaze izifundo zakho.
tier.gap.step4: Yehlisani izindleko ndawonye: phekani ngamaqembu, yabelanani ngedatha, nithenge izincwadi ezisetshenzisiwe.
tier.gap.step5: Khuluma ngokwethembeka nomndeni ngalokho okungenzeka, nokuthi nini.
tier.tight.title: Kwanele nje, akukho sikhala sokumangala
tier.tight.body: Imali yakho ikhava izidingo eziyisisekelo ({essentials}) futhi kusale u-{surplus}. Inkokhelo eyodwa ephuzile noma izindleko ezingalindelekile zizokushiya ushoda, ngakho qala ngokwakha imali encane eyisiphephelo.
tier.ok.title: Izidingo zikhavekile, kukhona isikhala
tier.ok.body: Uno-{surplus} ngenyanga ngaphezu kwezidingo eziyisisekelo. Faka ingxenye yayo emalini eyisiphephelo ngaphambi kokusebenzisa ezintweni ezengeziwe.
tier.strong.title: Ukhavekile kahle
tier.strong.body: Uno-{surplus} ngenyanga ngaphezu kwezidingo eziyisisekelo. Yakha imali eyisiphephelo okungenani yenyanga, futhi ubeke umkhawulo wokusebenzisa imali ekuzijabuliseni ukuze ingakhuli kancane kancane.

timeline.title: Isemesta yakho
dash.title: Isonto {n}
dash.firstIntro: Ufika no-{money} owuphethe usuka ekhaya. Nansi indlela isonto eliqala ngayo.
dash.lowWellbeing: Inhlalakahle yakho iphansi. Empilweni yangempela, lesi yisikhathi esihle sokukhuluma nothile.
dash.inDebt: Unesikweletu. Isonto ngalinye usesikweletini lengeza ingcindezi.
dash.lowMoney: Imali iyaphela. Ungacela usizo nganoma yisiphi isonto, hhayi kuphela uma ikhadi likunikeza lona.
dash.gapNotice: Imali yakho yanyanga zonke ingaphansi kwezindleko eziyisisekelo lapha, ngakho le semesta izoba nzima ngisho nezinqumo ezinhle. Akulona iphutha lakho, futhi usizo lungakwenza kube lula.
event.sensitive: Uma lokhu kukuthinta, usizo lumahhala, luyimfihlo futhi lukhona manje:
event.tradeoff: Ayikho impendulo eyodwa efanele lapha, kukhona ukuhwebelana kuphela.
event.keys: Ithiphu: cindezela u-1, 2 noma 3 ukuze ukhethe

plan.budgetNote: Izingxenye zemali yakho. Izidingo eziyisisekelo yizindleko eziyisibonelo eduze ne-{area}: shintsha noma iyiphi inombolo ifane nempilo yakho.
plan.datesNote: Uhlelo lwesikhathi oluyisibonelo. Hlola izinsuku eziqondile ekhalendeni lezemfundo le-{short}.
family.intro: Ngidlale i-University Simulator, ukuzilolongela impilo yasenyuvesi e-{inst}.
family.budget: Ngizoba no-{in} cishe ngenyanga, kanti izidingo eziyisisekelo zibiza cishe u-{essentials}.
family.gap: Lokho kushiya igebe lika-{gap} ngenyanga okufanele silihlele ndawonye.
family.late: Uma imali yami yephuza, uhlelo lwami yilolu:
family.together: Singahlela ndawonye? Masivumelane ukuthi ngingathumela malini ekhaya nyanga zonke, nokuthi imali ifika nini.

intro.1.title: Unyaka wokuqala yilapho abafundi beyeka khona
intro.1.body: Cishe abafundi bonyaka wokuqala abangu-620 000 baxhaswa yi-NSFAS ngo-2023. Cishe abangu-130 000 kuphela ababesaxhaswa ngonyaka olandelayo. Izinkinga ezibangela lokhu ziyabikezelwa: imali ephuzile, irenti, izicelo zomndeni nengcindezi yesonto lezivivinyo.
intro.2.title: Zilolongele ngaphambi kokuthi kube ngokoqobo
intro.2.body: Faka isimo sakho sangempela, bese udlala amasonto angu-8 emizuzwini engaba yi-10. Isonto ngalinye liletha isimo esisodwa nezinqumo ezimbili noma ezintathu. Bheka imali, amamaki nenhlalakahle yakho, bese ucela usizo ukuze ubone usizo amakhampasi alunikezayo.
intro.3.title: Uhambo lwakho, isahluko ngesahluko
intro.3.body: Qala ngokuthi Ukufika noma Itemu Lokuqala, bese ulandela uhambo lwakho kuze kube sekuthweswenikweziqu. Emva kwesahluko ngasinye, Isibikezelo Sesemesta sibikezela amasonto akho anobungozi kakhulu futhi sakhe uhlelo lokusinda ongalugcina noma wabelane ngalo ku-WhatsApp. Ayikho i-akhawunti, futhi usebenza ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi.
money.title: Isibikezelo semali yakho
money.lead: Ngaphambi kwesonto 1, nansi indlela imali yakho engase ihambe ngayo, ngokusekelwe ezimpendulweni zakho.
money.lateRunOut: Uma imali yakho yephuza ngamasonto angu-{n}, ngeke ukwazi ukukhokhela izidingo zakho ngesonto {week}.
money.lateOk: Ngisho imali yakho yephuza ngamasonto angu-{n}, ungakhokhela izidingo zakho.
money.onTimeRunOut: Ngisho ifika ngesikhathi, ngeke ukwazi ukukhokhela izidingo zakho ngesonto {week}.
money.onTimeOk: Uma ifika ngesikhathi, ungakhokhela izidingo zakho wonke amasonto angu-8.
money.weekly: Ukudla nezinto zokugeza kuthengwa kakhulu ekuqaleni kwenyanga ngayinye; ukugibela, idatha nokudla kwasekhampasi kuza masonto onke. Azikho izindleko ezithatha yonke imali yakho: uma ishoda uthenga okuncane, bese uphila ngaphandle kokunye. Cishe u-{income} ungena isonto ngalinye, futhi uqala no-{start}.
money.inGame: Emdlalweni imali yakho izofika sekwephuzile, njengoba kuvame ukwenzeka empilweni yangempela.
fc.title: Isibikezelo Sakho Sesemesta
fc.lead: Ngokusekelwe esimweni sakho nasezinqumweni ozenzile, nakhu lapho isemesta yakho yokuqala yangempela ingase ibe nezinkinga khona, nokuthi ungenzani ngakho.
fc.act.moneyNsfas: Bhalisela {food} futhi uxhumane no-{funding} ngaphambi kwesonto {week} le-{chapter}.
fc.act.money: Bhalisela {food} futhi uqinisekise izinsuku zokukhokha nomxhasi wakho ngaphambi kwesonto {week} le-{chapter}.
fc.act.wellbeing: Londoloza inombolo ka-{counselling} manje, futhi ubhukhe iseshini uma ukulala noma ingcindezi kwehla cishe ngesonto {week} le-{chapter}.
fc.act.housing: Khokhela kuphela indawo yokuhlala esohlwini olugunyaziwe, futhi kuphela emva kokuyibona.
fc.act.commute: Hlela isikhathi sokufunda ngokuya ngokugibela kwakho, futhi uhambe nabanye ebusuku.
fc.act.family: Vumelanani nekhaya ngenani lanyanga zonke ngaphambi kokuqala kwe-{chapter}.
fc.act.solo: Zijwayeze ukucela kusenesikhathi: ugweme usizo izikhathi ezingu-{n} kwezingu-{total}. Xhumana nensizakalo eyodwa engenhla ngesonto lakho lokuqala.
fc.howBody: Isibikezelo samanje sihlanganisa ukubala ukugeleza kwemali, amaphuzu esinqumo ngasinye, nemithetho esekelwe ocwaningweni lokuthi kungani abafundi beyeka. Akukabi yimodeli ye-AI eqeqeshiwe. Ngedatha engaziwa futhi enemvume evela ohlelweni lokuhlola, singafunda ukubikezela kangcono.
fb.title: Sisize sithuthuke (akuphoqelekile)
fb.body: Imibuzo emithathu esheshayo. Izimpendulo azaziwa: alikho igama, ayikho inombolo yocingo.
friday.title: NgoLwesihlanu
buffer.ok: Imali yakho eyisiphephelo ikumboze lokhu. Yilokho eyenzelwe kona.
buffer.short: Ngaphandle kwemali eyisiphephelo, awukwazanga ukukhokhela konke lokhu, futhi ukuhlala ngaphandle kwakho kuthinte inhlalakahle yakho. Uhlelo lwakho lunenani lemali eyisiphephelo.
fc.leaks: Ukusebenzisa imali okuncane kukubize u-{total} kule semesta: cishe u-{month} ngenyanga, noma amasonto angu-{weeks} emali yokudla.
fc.leaksGap: Lokho kungaphezu kokushoda kwakho kwanyanga zonke ka-{gap}.
fc.leaksNone: Ukusebenzisa imali okuncane ukugcine eduze kukaziro.
fc.act.leaks: Beka umkhawulo wanyanga zonke wokusebenzisa imali okuncane: emdlalweni kukubize cishe u-{month} ngenyanga.
fc.act.buffer: Yakha imali eyisiphephelo engu-{target} ngaphambi kokuqala kwetemu, ukuze izindleko ezingalindelekile zingakufaki esikweletini.
fc.act.lonely: Joyina iqembu elilodwa noma inhlangano kusenesikhathi ({societies}), futhi ulondoloze inombolo ka-{counselling}.
plan.bufferBody: Hlose u-{target}: cishe amasonto amabili ezidingo eziyisisekelo. Izindleko ezingalindelekile njengefoni entshontshiwe noma ijazi lelabhu zibe yinkinga encane, hhayi inhlekelele.
plan.bufferSave: Ukonga u-{amount} ngenyanga kukufikisa lapho ezinyangeni ezingaba ngu-{months}.
plan.bufferStart: Ngisho u-R50 ngenyanga uyasiza. Qala ngenkokhelo yakho yokuqala.

map.title: Uhambo lwakho
map.lead: Kusukela ku-matric kuya ekuthweswenikweziqu. Izahluko ezakhiwe zivulekile; ezimpunga zisohlelweni lwethu lwesikhathi esizayo.
map.resetWarn: Ukushintsha isimo sakho kuqala uhambo olusha.
note.title: Isaziso ngokuqukethwe
note.body: Ikhadi elilandelayo likhuluma ngodaba olubucayi, njengempilo yengqondo noma udlame lwezocansi. Libhalwe ngokucophelela futhi lixhumanisa nosizo lwangempela lwamahhala. Ungaleqa.
card.friendNote: Akukho maphuzu lapha: lokhu kumayelana nokuthi umsekela kanjani omunye umuntu.
buffer.saved: Imali yakho eyisiphephelo inciphise lokhu ngo-{saved}.
fc.leadNext: Ngokusekelwe kulesi sahluko, nakhu lapho i-{chapter} ingase ibe nzima khona kuwe, nokuthi ungenzani ngakho.
fc.leadFinal: Ngokusekelwe kukho konke okudlalile, nakhu lapho unyaka wakho wokugcina wangempela ungase ube nzima khona, nokuthi ungenzani ngakho.
fc.ahead: Sibheka phambili: awukayidlali i-{chapter}. Ngokusekelwe ezinqumweni ozenze ku-{current}, yilokhu okungase kwenzeke emasontweni ezayo, ukuze uzilungiselele manje.
fc.memory: Ku-{prev} u{pastVerb} izikhathi ezingu-{n} kwezingu-{total}. Kulesi sahluko u{nowVerb} izikhathi ezingu-{m} kwezingu-{mtotal}.
fc.act.funding: Hlola imithetho yokuqhubeka no-{advisor}, futhi ugcine u-{funding} eduze, ngaphambi kwesonto {week} le-{chapter}.
fc.act.debt: Yenza uhlelo lokukhokha no-{fees} ngaphambi kokuthi isikweletu sivimbe ukubhalisa noma isitifiketi sakho.
fc.act.career: Bhukha {careers} ukuthola usizo nge-CV nengxoxo yokuzilolonga ngaphambi kwesonto {week} le-{chapter}.

fair.lead.moderate: Isimo sakho sengeze ingcindezi ethile kusukela ekuqaleni.

home.title: University Simulator
home.about: Zilolongele inyuvesi ngaphambi kokuthi kube ngokoqobo. Dala umfundi wakho, uphile ngezikhathi ezikhipha abafundi baseNingizimu Afrika (imali ephuzile, izicelo zomndeni, amasonto ezivivinyo, isizungu), futhi ubone usizo olukhona ngaphambi kokuthi uludinge.
home.about2: Emva kwesahluko ngasinye, Isibikezelo Sesemesta sifunda izinqumo zakho, sibikezele amasonto akho anobungozi kakhulu futhi sakhe uhlelo lokusinda ongaluzigcinela.
home.card.setupNew: Dala umfundi wakho: inyuvesi, isifundo, ikhaya, imali nokunye. Kuthatha cishe umzuzu.
home.card.firstDesc: Ukufika, Itemu Lokuqala, Izivivinyo Zokuqala nokuBuyela Esimweni: unyaka abafundi abaningi abathola unzima kakhulu.
home.card.middleDesc: Unyaka wesibili nowesithathu: izimali ezindala, ukuthuthela ngaphandle kwekhampasi, ukukhetha isifundo esiyinhloko, imisebenzi eceleni nokukhathala.
home.card.finalDesc: Amaphrojekthi onyaka wokugcina, izicelo zemisebenzi, izikweletu ezindala nosuku lokuthweswa iziqu.
why.title: Ukungena akusikho okunzima. Ukuhlala kuyikho.
why.stat1: Cishe abafundi bonyaka wokuqala abangu-620 000 baxhaswa yi-NSFAS ngo-2023. Cishe abangu-130 000 kuphela ababesaxhaswa ngonyaka olandelayo.
why.stat2: Ezinye izilinganiso ziphakamisa ukuthi abafundi bonyaka wokuqala abangafika ku-60% bayahamba emva kwetemu labo lokuqala.
why.stat2src: Umthombo: Isikhulu Esiphezulu se-Fundi, ngokusho kwe-EWN
why.i1: Imali efika sekwephuzile, nerenti okufanele ikhokhwe ngaphambi kokuthi imali ifike
why.i3: Ayikho i-laptop, ayikho idatha, noma ukugibela okude
why.i5: Izivivinyo nemisebenzi okufika konke ngesonto elilodwa
why.i7: Ukusebenza, noma ukunakekela othile, ngenkathi ufunda
why.i8: Isifundo owehluleka kuso, noma izimali ezindala ezivimba ukubhalisa
why.everyone: Lokhu kungokwawo wonke umuntu: i-NSFAS, umxhaso, oxhaswa ngumndeni noma ozikhokhelayo; oqhamuka esikoleni noma obuya esemdala; ohlala e-res, oqashile noma ogibelayo; unyaka wokuqala noma osevele esonyakeni wesibili. Lezi zinkinga ziyabikezelwa, nosizo nalo luyabikezelwa.
how.title: Zilolonge, bese ugcina uhlelo
how.s1: Isimo sakho sangempela: inyuvesi, isifundo, indawo yokuhlala, uxhaso, imali, ikhaya nezibopho. Umdlalo wakhiwa ngakho.
how.s2: Isonto ngalinye liletha isimo sangempela nezinqumo ezimbili noma ezintathu. Bheka imali, amamaki nenhlalakahle yakho. Ungashintsha impendulo ngemva nje kokuyenza.
how.s3: Khetha ukuthola usizo uzobona uhlobo lwensizakalo amakhampasi alunikezayo, elukwenzayo nokuthi ungafinyelela kanjani kulo.
how.s4: Emva kwesahluko ngasinye, Isibikezelo Sesemesta sibikezela amasonto akho anobungozi kakhulu futhi sakhe uhlelo lokusinda ongalugcina noma wabelane ngalo ku-WhatsApp.
how.note: Phakathi kwezinyathelo kukhona ikhefu, lapho ungama khona ubuye kamuva. Kwesinye isikhathi linombuzo osheshayo ongawukhetha: lowo awuyona ingxenye yendaba eyinhloko futhi awushintshi imali, amamaki noma inhlalakahle yakho. Ayikho i-akhawunti. Isebenza ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi. Cishe imizuzu eyi-10 ye-First Term.
home.cardsLead: Dala umlingiswa wakho, bese udlala noma iyiphi ingxenye yohambo: abafundi abasacabanga, abonyaka wokuqala nalabo asebesonyakeni wesibili bonke bamukelekile.
friday.habitText: Abangane bakho baphuma cishe njalo ngoLwesihlanu, futhi ukuphuma kanye kubiza cishe u-{amount}. Uzophuma kangaki ngokuvamile?
friday.habitNote: Lokhu kuba umkhuba wakho: izindleko zisuswa ngokuzenzakalela isonto ngalinye, emva kokudla nezokuthutha. Ungakushintsha noma yiliphi isonto ebhodini.
ledger.nightsSkipped: Uhlale ekhaya: imali ibincane kakhulu ukuthi uphume
fc.subsYear: Kukonke lokho kucishe kube ngu-{amount} ngonyaka.
fc.subsNone: Akukho okubhaliselwe noma ama-debit order asebenzayo.

about.title: Mayelana ne-University Simulator
about.lead: Umdlalo omfushane lapho abafundi baseNingizimu Afrika bezilolongela impilo yasenyuvesi ngaphambi kokuba yenzeke.
about.p1: Udala umfundi ofana nawe, udlale izahluko ezimfushane kusukela ku-matric kuya ekuphotheleni, futhi uphathe imali, amamaki nenhlalakahle. Sonke isikhathi esinzima sinendlela yokuphuma, futhi kukhona ukunqoba endleleni.
about.p2: Emva kwesahluko ngasinye, isiBikezelo Sesemesta sifunda izinqumo zakho futhi sakhe uhlelo lokusinda ongaligcina. Isibikezelo sisebenzisa imithetho ecacile esekelwe ocwaningweni, hhayi imodeli ye-AI eqeqeshiwe.
about.independent: INyuvesi yaseSizwe iqanjiwe. Le app izimele, futhi ayihlobene nanoma iyiphi inyuvesi noma ivunywe yiyo.
about.advice: Lokhu akusona iseluleko sochwepheshe, sezimali, sezomthetho noma sezempilo. Ukuze uthole usizo oluphuthumayo, sebenzisa izinombolo zikazwelonke eziboniswe ku-app.
about.numbers: Amanani, imithetho nezinsuku kuyizibonelo. Hlola okwangempela nenyuvesi yakho nomxhasi wakho.
uni.title: Ikhampasi yakho, emdlalweni
uni.lead: Umboniso usebenzisa ikhampasi eqanjiwe. Inguqulo enelayisense inika abafundi bakho ukuzilolongela inyuvesi yakho, enezinsizakalo zakho nezindleko zakho.
uni.s1: Yonke ikhadi, izindleko nensizakalo yosizo kuyidatha. Iphakethe lakho libiza amahhovisi akho angempela, indlela yokufinyelela kuwo nokuthi izinto zibiza malini eduze nekhampasi yakho.
uni.s2: Ithimba lakho Lezindaba Zabafundi lihlola wonke amakhadi osizo nokuqukethwe okuzwelayo ngaphambi kokuthi abafundi bakubone. Izibuyekezo zifika kubafundi ngaphandle kwe-app entsha.
uni.s3: Ubona ukuthi bangaki abafundi abaqede isahluko ngasinye nokuthi batheni. Awekho amagama, akukho ukungena, awekho amarekhodi abafundi.
uni.s4: Amalayisense ngawesikhungo ngasinye nangonyaka, ngamazinga ngokwenani labafundi. Ikhampasi yokubonisa yaseSizwe ihlala imahhala ukuyizama.
uni.contact: Sifuna inyuvesi eyodwa noma ezimbili zokuhlola inguqulo yekhampasi ngo-2027. Khuluma nethimba elikubonise le app.
privacy.title: Ubumfihlo, ngolimi olulula
privacy.lead: Ayikho i-akhawunti futhi akukho ukungena. Asiceli igama lakho, inombolo noma inombolo yomfundi.
privacy.p1: Izimpendulo zakho, izinqumo nenqubekela phambili kugcinwa kule divayisi kuphela.
privacy.p2: I-Campus Realities ayilandelelwa. Akukho lutho mayelana nalokho okuvulayo lapho olugcinwayo noma oluthunyelwayo, ngisho nakudivayisi yakho.
privacy.p3: Uma uqeda isahluko futhi uxhumekile, i-app ingathumela isibalo esingaziwa: ikhodi yedivayisi engahleliwe negama lesahluko. Izimpendulo zempendulo zithunyelwa kuphela uma uthepha okuthi Thumela.
privacy.p4: Uma uhlelo olubhalwe yi-AI luvuliwe, kuthunyelwa izinombolo zesibikezelo sakho kuphela ukuze lubhalwe. Awekho amagama, futhi akukho okuthayiphile.
privacy.p5: Ukwabelana ngohlelo lwakho lokusinda kuyisinqumo sakho, futhi luya kuphela lapho uluthumela khona.
cr.title: Amaqiniso Asekhampasi
cr.lead: Ezinye izinto ekhampasi kunzima ukukhuluma ngazo. Le ngxenye ikusiza uzibone, wazi izindlela zakho futhi usekele umngane.
cr.note: Inothi lokuqukethwe: lezi zihloko zihlanganisa ukucwasa nodlame lwezocansi. Funda ngesivinini sakho, futhi uphume noma nini. Usizo lwamahhala, oluyimfihlo luyatholakala manje:
cr.topicNote: Amakhadi alandelayo achaza lesi sihloko ngokucacile, anesimo esifushane. Akukho okutholwa amaphuzu, futhi akukho okubukayo okugcinwayo. Ukuthi Phuma ngokushesha kukubuyisela ngqo ezihlokweni.
cr.private: Akukho lutho mayelana nalokho okubukayo lapha olugcinwayo noma oluthunyelwayo.
cr.notReviewed: La mazwi awuhlaka, futhi asazobuyekezwa nguchwepheshe wokusekela abafundi.
cr.reviewed: La mazwi abuyekezwe nguchwepheshe wokusekela abafundi.
cr.noScore: Akukho lapha okutholwa amaphuzu. Khetha inketho ukuze ubone ukuthi ivame ukuholela kuphi.
cr.youNote: Izindlela, ngesivinini sakho. Akukho ngcindezi yokubika.
cr.fromCard: Kukhona okwengeziwe ngalokhu ku-Campus Realities, esikrinini sasekhaya. Kuyakhethwa.
cr.cardDesc: Izingxenye ezinzima zempilo yasekhampasi: ukucwasa, ukuhlukunyezwa nokuphepha. Zibone, wazi izindlela zakho futhi usekele umngane.

fc.details: Bona imininingwane: ingozi ngesonto, indlela obhekane ngayo, ukusebenzisa imali
link.leaving: Lokhu kuvula iwebhusayithi esemthethweni kusiphequluli sakho. Kusebenzisa idatha.
link.noSite: INyuvesi yase-{short} iqanjiwe, ngakho ayikho iwebhusayithi engavulwa. Ekhampasi enelayisense lokhu kuya ekhasini lenyuvesi uqobo.
coach.homeSetup: Qala lapha: thinta u-"Dala umlingiswa" ukuze umise umfundi ofana nawe. Kuthatha cishe umzuzu. Ngemva kwalokho ukhetha lapho uqala khona: akudingeki udlale izingxenye ngokulandelana.
coach.homeYears: Thepha "Vula" kunoma iyiphi ingxenye yohambo. Akudingeki uzidlale ngokulandelana.
coach.recap: Lezi yizinsizakalo ongakahlangani nazo. Thepha eyodwa ukuze ubone ukuthi inikezani, ikuphi nokuthi ufinyelela kanjani kuyo.
coach.card: Funda isimo, bese uthepha impendulo eyodwa. Ungayishintsha ngemva nje kwalokho.
coach.outcome: Yilokhu isinqumo sakho esiholele kukho. Thepha inkinobho engezansi ukuze uqhubeke, noma "Shintsha impendulo yami" ukuze uzame enye.
coach.support: Isinqumo sakho sivule insizakalo yosizo. Thepha "Bona usizo" ukuze uthole ukuthi inikezani nokuthi ufinyelela kanjani kuyo.
coach.reach: Thepha ibalazwe, i-imeyili noma inkinobho yekhasi ukuze ubone kahle ukuthi uya kuphi. Konke okuvulayo kugcinwa ohlelweni lwakho lokusinda.
coach.break: Leli yikhefu phakathi kwezinyathelo. Ungama lapha ubuye kamuva: inqubekela phambili yakho igciniwe.
coach.mini: Lona ngumbuzo ongawukhetha. Awuyona ingxenye yendaba eyinhloko futhi awushintshi imali, amamaki noma inhlalakahle yakho. Wuphendule noma uweqe.
coach.forecast: Lesi yisibikezelo sakho: amasonto akho ayingozi kakhulu nokuthi wenzeni ngawo. Thepha "Bona imininingwane" ukuthola okwengeziwe, bese uqhubekela ohlelweni lwakho lokusinda.
setup.campusHint: Ikhampasi ngayinye inebalazwe layo, izinsizakalo nezindleko zendawo. Amanye amahhovisi enyuvesi aseKhampasi Enkulu kuphela.
setup.noMatch: Asikho isikhungo esihambisana nalokho. Zama igama elifushane.
setup.needOnline: Xhuma ku-inthanethi kanye ukuze ulande lesi sikhungo. Emva kwalokho sisebenza ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi.
svc.title: Izinsizakalo zasekhampasi
svc.cardDesc: Thola usizo ngalokho obhekene nakho, noma nini: "Ngilambile", "Ngicindezelekile", "Ngithole ikhodi yemiphumela".
svc.lead: Thepha lokho obhekene nakho ukuze ubone ukuthi ubani osizayo, bakuphi nokuthi ubathola kanjani.
svc.guest: Lezi yizinsizakalo zase-{inst}. Dala umlingiswa wakho ukuze ubone ezasekhampasi yakho.
svc.visiting: Umngane wabelane nawe ngalokhu. Lezi yizinsizakalo zase-{inst}, hhayi ezasekhampasi yakho.
svc.shareLink: Bona ukuthi lukuphi nokuthi uluthola kanjani:
coach.terms: Amagama abhalwe ngombala ogqamile ayathepheka. Thepha elilodwa ukuze ubone ukuthi lisho ukuthini.
coach.services: Ungazithola futhi zonke izinsizakalo, noma nini, ngaphansi kokuthi "Izinsizakalo zasekhampasi" esikrinini sasekhaya.
